(platyphylline) Profile Platyphylline acid tartrate is a pyrrolizidine alkaloid occurring in Senecio platyphyllus and other Senecio spp. It has antimuscarinic actions and has been given with papaverine in antispasmodic preparations. Profile Plaunotol is a complex aliphatic alcohol extracted from the Thai medicinal plant plau-noi (Croton sublyratus (Euphorbiaceae)). It is reported to possess cytoprotective properties and has been used in the treatment of gastritis and peptic ulcer disease in an oral dose of 80 mg three times daily.
